summary: Optical Cable Corp filed an 8-K to report entering into a $2,650,000 Business Loan Agreement with Freedom First Federal Credit Union, and simultaneously terminating an existing real estate loan with Northeast Bank. The new loan matures May 1, 2036, and is secured by real estate and rents. This is a routine refinancing of indebtedness with no equity component, no change of control, and no special-situation element such as a sale or restructuring. The filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement. There are no deal terms relevant to a special situation.
